Install Launcher

Launcher is the browser extension that opens these link groups from your toolbar. Browsers don't allow a website to install an extension silently, so this packages the latest build for you and walks through the one-time load — no Web Store needed.

  1. Download the extension
    Always packages the latest files straight from GitHub.
  2. Unzip it to a folder you'll keep (e.g. Documents). The extension runs from that folder — don't delete it afterwards.
  3. Open your browser's extensions page (Chrome — it can't be opened by a click, so copy & paste it):
    chrome://extensions
    Firefox loads it as a temporary add-on via about:debugging (pick manifest.json) and drops it on restart. Brave / Chrome / Edge / Opera keep it loaded.
  4. Turn on Developer mode (toggle, top-right of that page).
  5. Click Load unpacked and select the unzipped Launcher folder.
  6. Pin Launcher to your toolbar — click it and these link groups appear. Edits you make here sync to it automatically, and reordering cards there syncs back here.
  7. Already installed? Launcher doesn't self-update when loaded unpacked. To get the newest version: download again, replace the old Launcher folder with the new one (same path), then hit Reload on the extensions page.
